diagnosis: Scaling from SF1 to SF10 increased absolute runtimes but did not produce two confidence-authorized, query-dependent winners. Q3 aggregate materialization was only 1.397% faster than fused, while Q10 fused led the aggregate-materialized candidate by only 1.535%. These differences remain below the preregistered 3% materiality boundary or are not separated by the paired 95% confidence interval.
decision: Permanently stop the TPC-H Q3/Q10 multicandidate optimizer-expansion branch. Do not relax the 3% threshold, alter the data, add post-hoc candidates, or rerun the same protocol to manufacture winner labels.
retained_value: The run positively confirms exact official-result equivalence, three distinct physical plans per query, stable paired timing, and spill-free SF10 execution. It is retained as negative boundary evidence, not optimizer-performance evidence.
scientific_boundary: This negative result does not invalidate exact TPC-H Q1/Q3/Q6/Q10 semantic coverage, accepted Q1/Q6 evidence, the successful governed-pipeline independent holdout, the successful policy-stratified BTS/NYC optimizer holdout, lineage scalability, or the multisource end-to-end case study.
